<style>

/* -- DESIGN TOKENS -- */
:root {
  --gold:    #AB9461;
  --gold-2:  #C9B17A;
  --navy:    #274472;
  --slate:   #67738B;
  --dark:    #1C2635;
  --muted:   #6B6258;
  --bg:      #F5F2EE;
  --bg-mid:  #EDE7DB;
  --surface: #FAFAF8;
  --border:  #DDD8D0;
  --white:   #FFFFFF;
  --font-display: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  --font-body:    'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { font-size: 16px; }
body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--dark);
  min-height: 100vh;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
/* -- PAGE -- */
.page-wrap {
  max-width: 1060px; margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 70px 32px 80px;
}
/* -- HERO -- */
.checkout-hero {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
  animation: fadeUp 0.55s ease both;
}
.eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.checkout-hero h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(34px, 5vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy);
}
.checkout-hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--gold); }
.checkout-hero p {
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.3vw, 26px);
  line-height: 1.4; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 600;
  max-width: 640px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
}
/* -- GRID -- */
.checkout-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px;
  gap: 28px;
  align-items: start;
  animation: fadeUp 0.65s 0.08s ease both;
}
/* -- LEFT COLUMN -- */
.left-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
/* Payment panel */
.payment-panel {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}
.panel-header {
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 24px 32px;
}
.panel-header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--white);
}
.panel-body { padding: 32px; }
/* Plan tabs */
.plan-tabs {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr);
  gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 28px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.plan-tab {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 10px 14px;
  text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, background 0.18s;
  background: var(--surface); position: relative;
}
.plan-tab:hover { border-color: var(--gold); }
.plan-tab.active {
  border-color: var(--gold);
  background: #FBF8F3;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--gold);
}
.plan-tab .tab-label {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
  display: block; margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
}
.plan-tab .tab-sub {
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
}
.plan-tab .tab-price {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark);
  line-height: 1; display: block;
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
}
.plan-tab .tab-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 4px; display: block;
}
.plan-tab .popular-badge,
.plan-tab .value-badge {
  position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.plan-tab .popular-badge { background: var(--gold); color: var(--white); }
.plan-tab .value-badge   { background: var(--navy); color: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--gold); }
.plan-tab .tab-klarna {
  display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: #FFB3C7; color: #1A1A1A;
  padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Divider */
.divider {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.divider span {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap;
}
.divider::before, .divider::after {
  content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border);
}
/* Buttons */
.btn-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.btn {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 15px 22px;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, filter 0.15s;
}
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn-vipps  { background: #FF5B24; color: #fff; }
.btn-vipps:hover  { box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(255,91,36,0.32); }
.btn-klarna { background: #FFB3C7; color: #1A1A1A; }
.btn-klarna:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); }
.btn-card   { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
.btn-card:hover   { box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(39,68,114,0.28); }
/* Guarantee */
.guarantee {
  display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
}
.guarantee-icon {
  width: 46px; height: 46px; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--bg-mid); border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold);
}
.guarantee h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--dark); margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.guarantee p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--muted);
}
/* -- RIGHT COLUMN -- */
.right-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
/* Summary */
.summary-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden;
}
.summary-top {
  background: var(--bg-mid);
  padding: 20px 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.summary-top h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--dark);
}
.summary-body { padding: 22px 26px; }
.s-row {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: 14px;
}
.s-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.s-row .s-item {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
}
.s-row .s-sub {
  color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px;
}
.s-row .s-val {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--dark);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.s-row.bonus { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(171,148,97,0.07), transparent); margin: 0 -26px; padding-left: 26px; padding-right: 26px; }
.s-row.bonus .s-item { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; }
.s-row.bonus .s-original {
  color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: 11px;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
.s-row.bonus .s-val  { color: var(--gold); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.s-row.bonus.unavailable {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(107,98,88,0.05), transparent);
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.s-row.bonus.unavailable .s-item { color: var(--muted); }
.s-row.bonus.unavailable .s-original { text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted); }
.s-row.bonus.unavailable .s-val { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
.s-row.total {
  padding-top: 16px; margin-top: 4px;
  border-top: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-bottom: none;
}
.s-row.total .s-item {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark);
}
.s-row.total .s-val {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy);
  font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums;
}
.savings-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--white);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
/* Testimonial */
.testimonial-card {
  background: var(--navy); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 30px 26px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.testimonial-card::before {
  content: '\201C';
  position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 110px; line-height: 1;
  color: var(--gold); opacity: 0.18;
}
.t-stars { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.t-stars span { color: var(--gold); font-size: 12px; }
.t-quote {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 18px; font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.6; color: var(--white);
  position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.t-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.t-avatar {
  width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--slate); border: 2px solid rgba(171,148,97,0.6);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white);
}
.t-name {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white);
}
.t-role {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-top: 2px;
}
/* Included list */
.included-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 22px 26px;
}
.included-card .inc-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.inc-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; }
.inc-list li {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5;
}
.inc-list li.bonus-item { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; }
.inc-check {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--bg-mid); border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.inc-value {
  display: block;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
/* -- FINAL CTA / LIMITED CAPACITY -- */
.final-cta {
  margin-top: 36px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FBF8F3 0%, var(--bg-mid) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 36px 36px 34px;
  text-align: center;
  animation: fadeUp 0.7s 0.15s ease both;
}
.capacity-warning {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 16px 7px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.capacity-dot {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(171,148,97,0.18);
  animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.capacity-warning strong { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
.final-cta h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 30px);
  font-weight: 500; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.25;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.final-cta p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 22px;
}
.cta-button {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--white);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 17px 38px; border-radius: 9px;
  text-decoration: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}
.cta-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  background: var(--gold-2);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(171,148,97,0.4);
}
.cta-button svg { transition: transform 0.2s; }
.cta-button:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }
/* -- FOOTER -- */
.checkout-footer {
  margin-top: 56px; text-align: center;
  padding-top: 28px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.footer-logo {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--gold);
  display: block; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.checkout-footer p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7;
}
.checkout-footer a { color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; }
/* -- INLINE TRUST BAR (guarantee above CTAs) -- */
.trust-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FBF8F3 0%, var(--bg-mid) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.trust-icon {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid rgba(171,148,97,0.5);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: var(--gold);
}
.trust-title {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.trust-sub {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
/* -- ANIMATIONS -- */
@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(171,148,97,0.18); }
  50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(171,148,97,0.06); }
}
/* -- RESPONSIVE -- */
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .page-wrap { padding: 100px 18px 60px; }
  .checkout-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .left-col  { order: 1; }
  .right-col { order: 2; }
  .summary-card   { order: 1; }
  .included-card  { order: 2; }
  .testimonial-card { order: 3; }
  .plan-tabs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 14px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .final-cta { padding: 28px 22px; }
}

  if (paymentTabs && window.MutationObserver) {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      paymentTabs.querySelectorAll('.plan-tab').forEach(tab => tab.setAttribute('aria-pressed',tab.classList.contains('active')?'true':'false'));
    });
    observer.observe(paymentTabs,{attributes:true,subtree:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  }

  // Grouped, scroll-snapped carousel. All original sales-page testimonials appear as accessible slides.
  const viewport = document.getElementById('review-viewport');
  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.review-card'));
  const btnPrev = document.getElementById('review-prev');
  const btnNext = document.getElementById('review-next');
  const count = document.getElementById('review-count');
  const progress = document.getElementById('review-progress-fill');
  const filters = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.review-filter'));
  let shown = cards.slice();

  function visibleCount(){ return window.matchMedia('(max-width:600px)').matches ? 1 : 2; }
  function stride() { if (!shown.length) return 0; const c=shown[0]; const track=document.getElementById('review-track');return c.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap || 16); }
  function maxIndex(){return Math.max(0,shown.length-visibleCount());}
  function currentIndex(){return stride()? Math.min(maxIndex(),Math.max(0,Math.round(viewport.scrollLeft/stride()))):0;}
  function updateCarouselUI(){
    const start = currentIndex();
    const end = Math.min(shown.length, start+visibleCount());
    count.textContent = shown.length ? (start+1)+'–'+end+' av '+shown.length+' historier' : 'Ingen historier';
    progress.style.width=shown.length ? Math.max(8,(end/shown.length)*100)+'%':'0%';
    btnPrev.disabled = start===0;
    btnNext.disabled = end>=shown.length;
  }
  function navigate(direction){
    const next = Math.min(maxIndex(),Math.max(0,currentIndex()+direction));
    viewport.scrollTo({left: next*stride(), behavior: window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches?'instant':'smooth'});
    setTimeout(updateCarouselUI,280);
  }
  btnPrev.addEventListener('click',()=>navigate(-1));
  btnNext.addEventListener('click',()=>navigate(1));
  filters.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click',() => {
    const value = button.dataset.filter;
    filters.forEach(b => {const active=b===button;b.classList.toggle('active',active);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',active?'true':'false');});
    shown = cards.filter(card => value === 'alle' || card.dataset.category.split(' ').includes(value));
    cards.forEach(card=>{card.hidden=!shown.includes(card);});
    viewport.scrollTo({left:0,behavior:'instant'});
    updateCarouselUI();
  }));
  viewport.addEventListener('scroll',()=>requestAnimationFrame(updateCarouselUI),{passive:true});
  viewport.addEventListener('keydown',evt => {if(evt.key==='ArrowRight'){evt.preventDefault();navigate(1);}if(evt.key==='ArrowLeft'){evt.preventDefault();navigate(-1);}});
  window.addEventListener('resize',updateCarouselUI,{passive:true});
  updateCarouselUI();
})();

</script>
